resources.string: Local CMS/CAdES cryptographic integrity check, without network queries. Certificate trust, validity and revocation are not checked, and timestamps are not validated.
Local files only: CMS up to 1 MiB and original content up to 512 KiB. PDF and XML are not supported.
The original is only needed for detached signatures. A selected empty file counts as content; it is not the same as no selection. If the CMS already includes the content, do not add an original.
Cancelling discards the result and clears owned bytes when the operation exits. Some providers or computations cannot be interrupted immediately and may delay the next check.
Signature integrity checked. This does not establish certificate trust or validity.
Integrity not checked: invalid signature, modified content or mismatched original. If the CMS includes the content, remove the optional original.
Unsupported CMS/CAdES profile. Integrity not checked.
Limit exceeded: CMS up to 1 MiB and original up to 512 KiB. Integrity not checked.
This detached signature needs the original content. Select it and press Verify.
The files could not be read or checked. Select local files again.
